notes.general_comments:
Overall performance across individual questions varied significantly. Candidates were particularly successful
in relation to microeconomic based questions.
Questions 1, 2, 5, 14, 10, 15, and 16 were answered most successfully. These questions covered the full
range of skills but the majority assessed microeconomic syllabus topics.
Questions 3, 13, 19, 22, 23, 26, and 28, were answered correctly by fewer than 55 per cent of the
candidates.
